run_render_cli: run the fairnr render CLI to generate images from a neural rendering model checkpoint
run_main_generation: run main with args to load a model ensemble and generate rendered output images
run_inference_step: run task inference_step with a generator and models to produce output files from samples
build_generator: build a generator from the task using task.build_generator(args) for neural rendering
save_images: save rendered output images using generator.save_images with optional combine_output flag
